clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Velinde's Key guards the writings of a vanished priestess. Thyn'tel Bladeweaver entrusts it to those who bring proof of their interest in Velinde Starsong's fate.

Thyn'tel Bladeweaver keeps Velinde's Key in Darnassus. The simple key secures Priestess Velinde Starsong's personal belongings in a footlocker in the Sentinel bunkhouse above the Tradesmen's Terrace. Velinde left night elf lands without warning, and her possessions were set aside. Bladeweaver gives the key only to those who bring genuine evidence of their interest in learning her fate, such as revelations found in the Tome of Mel'Thandris.
